ObjectName: Lucien Frank, Residence of King Albert I of Belgium during WWI in De Panne, painted 1915
ImageDescription: Lucien Frank, Residence of King Albert I of Belgium during WWI in De Panne, painted by 1912[1]; published in L'Art et les artistes (Paris), special issue "La Belgique Heroïque et Martyre ", 1915, p. 53, which notes that the painting was at that time in the collection of the Musée de Luxumbourg. The museum's collection was dispersed to other French institutions in 1937. The subsequent and present location of the painting has not been traced.
